answer.label: In short

MMC runs AI by MMC for you: product photoshoots, UGC and spokesperson videos, video generation, landing pages and sales agents, produced from your client's brief, checked by people and delivered under your brand.

stages.breaks: Prompting without the client's brand rules.
stages.why: The output looks plausible and wrong, so your client rejects it and trust drops.
stages.does: We capture voice, colours and do-not rules from the brief and apply them to every piece.

stages.k: Put a person in the loop
stages.breaks: Sending raw AI output to a client.
stages.why: Garbled labels, odd hands and invented claims are easy to spot and hard to forgive.
stages.does: Every piece is read and fixed by a person before delivery, and rejected drafts never reach you.

stages.k: Be clear on rights and disclosure
stages.why: Clients ask who owns the output and whether they must say it is AI-made. You need an answer ready.
stages.does: Ownership terms are in the agreement, and every delivery has a usage note you can forward.

stages.breaks: Letting every client's output look alike.
stages.why: A generic AI feel makes your clients look like each other, and makes you look interchangeable.
stages.does: Brand rules and references are kept per client, so each set of work stays recognisable.

stages.k: Package it so it can be sold
stages.breaks: Offering AI as a vague idea.
stages.why: A client cannot buy something you cannot name, scope and describe in a line.
stages.does: We help you scope AI photoshoots, UGC, video, landing pages and sales agents as products with a written deliverable.
